target.title: fix(usage): omit costUsd when model pricing is all-zero (unknown)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Runtime usage emission (`buildUsage` in `src/plugins/runtime/runtime-llm.runtime.ts`) always trusted `estimateUsageCost`, even when the resolved cost config was all-zero. Some providers (e.g. codex) ship `cost {input:0,output:0,...}` in the generated `models.json` because the backend exposes no per-token price. Such an all-zero config is indistinguishable from "pricing unknown", yet the code emitted a confident `$0`. That silently blinds every budget/spike safeguard that keys off `costUsd`/`totalCost`.

Related: openclaw/openclaw#106080 — this PR intentionally does **not** close the issue; the broader pricing-cache/discovery investigation remains open there.

## Why This Change Was Made

The summary/aggregation path already guards this exact case in `src/infra/session-cost-usage.ts` (`isModelPricingKnown`), but the runtime-emission path (`buildUsage`) did not. This change mirrors that existing guard so both paths agree: when pricing is unknown (all-zero and no tiered pricing and no explicit provider-billed cost), `costUsd` is omitted rather than reported as `$0`.

**Follow-up fix caught by the requested live proof (commit 2):** the AssistantMessage `usage` object produced by the provider adapters always carries a `cost` object whose totals default to `0`, so the explicit-cost branch read every unbilled completion as an authoritative `$0` and the omission never fired on the real path (the original unit test mocked usage without the adapter's default cost object, masking this). Explicit cost now requires `cost.totalOrigin === "provider-billed"` provenance (set by `applyProviderReportedUsageCost`); adapter-default zeros fall through to the pricing-known estimate path. The omit test now mirrors the real adapter usage shape.

## User Impact

Models with all-zero pricing (codex and similar) no longer report a misleading confident `$0` runtime cost. Downstream budget/spike safeguards that treat `costUsd` presence as "known" now correctly see the cost as unknown. Explicit provider-billed costs (e.g. OpenRouter-style billed totals) remain present unchanged.

## Evidence

Live runtime proof (final head `a71a6c7b2f8`, 2026-07-19): real config loader + real `createRuntimeLlm` + real provider machinery over real HTTP to a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint (SSE streaming, `api: openai-completions`), tsx-driven, no module mocks. The configured model declares all-zero cost (the codex `models.json` case). Two runs per build: unbilled response, then a response carrying provider-billed `usage.cost: 0.0042`.

Before — `origin/main` (`runtime-llm.runtime.ts` verified identical to main):

```text
[all-zero pricing] result.usage: {"inputTokens":11,"outputTokens":7,"cacheReadTokens":0,"cacheWriteTokens":0,"totalTokens":18,"costUsd":0}
[all-zero pricing] costUsd present: true        <-- confident $0 reported for unknown pricing
[provider-billed cost] result.usage: {..."totalTokens":18,"costUsd":0.0042}
```

Before — first PR head `f97b851a9` (proof that the mocked test masked the real path):

```text
[all-zero pricing] result.usage: {..."totalTokens":18,"costUsd":0}
[all-zero pricing] costUsd present: true        <-- adapter-default zero read as explicit cost
```

After — final head `a71a6c7b2f8`:

```text
[all-zero pricing] result.usage: {"inputTokens":11,"outputTokens":7,"cacheReadTokens":0,"cacheWriteTokens":0,"totalTokens":18}
[all-zero pricing] costUsd present: false       <-- omitted; token counts retained
[provider-billed cost] result.usage: {..."totalTokens":18,"costUsd":0.0042}
[provider-billed cost] costUsd present: true    <-- provider-billed totals preserved
```

Regression tests (final head):

```bash
pnpm test src/plugins/runtime/runtime-llm.runtime.test.ts
```

```text
Tests  23 passed (23)
```

The omit test now feeds the adapter-realistic usage shape (default zero cost object) and the explicit-cost fixture is marked `totalOrigin: "provider-billed"` to match the adapter contract.

## What was not tested

- A full gateway agent turn with a live commercial provider; the proof exercises the exact `runtime.llm.complete` → `buildUsage` emission path over real HTTP with real config loading.
- The broader pricing-cache/discovery aspect of #106080 (external catalog population) is out of scope for this PR; see the issue for that investigation.
